features.title: New thread screen branding and shortcuts
features.summary: Replaces the DeepSeek mark and headline on the New thread screen and lists the project's recent threads and thread workspaces with work to land.

configuration.constraints: Up to three unarchived threads of the selected project.

failureModes: Without jj-integration the unlanded count stays hidden.
The headline hides native elements by CSS class suffix, which a DSH update can rename.
